選擇性捕殺大量小海豹的計劃引起了環保組織的強烈憤慨。

NONE: › If an event or series of events culminates in something, it ends with it, having developed until it reaches this point.
以…告終；達到…的頂點

我和老闆的爭吵日益惡化，直到最終我決定換工作。

經過多年研究，他們終於開發出一種能治癒該病的藥物。

NONE: › deserving to be blamed or considered responsible for something bad

T: C1 to prepare land and grow crops on it, or to grow a particular crop
C2 to try to develop and improve something

› If you cultivate a relationship, you make a special effort to establish and develop it, because you think it might be useful to you.

example: Most of the land there is too poor to cultivate.
那裡大部分土地太貧瘠，無法耕種。

村民們主要種植玉米和豆類。

新任首相將與東亞國家發展關係。

NONE: › Someone who is cultivated has had a good education and knows a lot about and likes art, music, painting, etc.
有教養的，有修養的，高雅的

已墾殖的；用於耕作的
